channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Trump "not satisfied" with new peace deal offered by Iran as standoff's costs multiply
item.description: Iran proposed new talks with the US to end the war. The standoff's costs are increasing. Live Updates: Iran offers new proposal for talks with U. S. to end war as standoff's costs multiply CBS News.

item.title: After Canada loosens citizenship requirements, thousands of people apply
item.description: A Canadian law change has opened citizenship opportunities, attracting thousands of Americans who are applying for Canadian citizenship for political and personal reasons. Many are motivated by a desire to escape US politics and policies.

item.title: A deadline for the Iran war is here. What does the War Powers Act say?
item.description: The War Powers Act deadline for the Iran war is here. The act requires presidential reporting. A deadline for the Iran war is here. What does the War Powers Act say?

item.title: Trump says will raise US tariffs on EU cars to 25%
item.description: US tariffs on EU cars and trucks will rise to 25 per cent from next week, US President Trump announced, accusing the European Union of not following a previous trade deal. The increase will take effect on 12 April 2026.

item.title: Trump tells Congress ceasefire means he does not need their approval for Iran war
item.description: US President Trump claims congressional approval is no longer needed for a war with Iran, citing a ceasefire as proof hostilities have terminated. He made the statement in a letter to Congress on 10 April 2026.

item.title: Trump says 'not satisfied' with new Iran proposal sent through Pakistan
item.description: The US administration has declared its war in Iran terminated, 60 days before a deadline to seek congressional approval. The decision comes after a ceasefire was brokered in the region.

item.title: US judge bars Trump from ending protected status for Yemeni nationals
item.description: A US judge has blocked the Trump administration from ending protected status for Yemeni nationals, part of a broader immigration crackdown. The administration had sought to cancel temporary protections for 13 countries.

item.title: The Risk That Could Break Banks
item.description: Gas prices rose to $4.39 per gallon in a single day. Geopolitics: The Risk That Could Break Banks Forbes.

item.title: U.S. Indictment of Sinaloa’s Governor Is a Reckoning for Residents of the Mexican State
item.description: The US indicted Sinaloa's governor for organized crime ties. The U. S. indictment of a Mexican governor confirms what many residents say they had long suspected: The line between organized crime and the upper echelons of government has blurred.

item.title: Israel Said to Have Helped Defend Emirates in Iran War With Iron Dome
item.description: Israel reportedly helped defend the UAE with its Iron Dome missile defense system during the Iran war. The Emirates bore the brunt of Iran's retaliatory attacks on Gulf countries. It appeared to be the first time the missile defense system was sent to an Arab country.

item.title: Gas prices hit $4.39 per gallon in biggest one-day jump since Iran ceasefire announced
item.description: Gas prices jumped to $4.39 per gallon after the Iran ceasefire. Gas prices hit $4.39 per gallon in biggest one-day jump since Iran ceasefire announced NBC News.

item.title: Turkish police fire tear gas, arrest hundreds at Istanbul May Day rallies
item.description: Turkish police arrested over 500 people at Istanbul May Day rallies. Over 500 people were arrested by Turkish police during May Day protests in Istanbul, with tear gas used to stop marches toward Taksim Square.

item.title: China and America Are Courting Nuclear Catastrophe
item.description: China and the US are increasing their nuclear arsenals and tensions. China and America Are Courting Nuclear Catastrophe Foreign Affairs.

item.title: Cuba holds May Day celebrations amid US threats
item.description: Cuba held May Day celebrations as the US announced further sanctions on the island. March celebrating International Workers' Day coincided with announcement of further US sanctions on island. Cuba holds May Day celebrations amid US threats.

item.title: Nuclear fears resurface among younger generations amid global tensions
item.description: Younger generations have renewed nuclear fears amid global tensions. Nuclear fears resurface among younger generations amid global tensions UN News.

item.title: China Says UN Should Revisit Lebanon Peacekeeping Mission Decision
item.description: China wants the UN to revisit its Lebanon peacekeeping mission decision. China Says UN Should Revisit Lebanon Peacekeeping Mission Decision U. S. News & World Report.

item.title: In Packed Cafes, Iranians Yearn to Escape War’s Wreckage
item.description: Iranians gather in cafes to discuss hopes and fears. Cafes and coffee shops give Iranians affordable places to talk about their hopes, fears and the cost of living as well as to seek company in uncertain times.

item.title: Trump says Iran seeks terms he ‘can’t agree to’ in latest peace proposal
item.description: Trump rejected Iran's peace proposal terms sent via Pakistan. Trump says the Iranian offer sent via Pakistan contains terms he's not satisfied with. Trump says Iran seeks terms he ‘can’t agree to’ in latest peace proposal.

item.title: US targets Chinese oil terminal in new Iran sanctions
item.description: The US imposed new sanctions on Iran, targeting its ability to move funds. The US Treasury Secretary said it will “relentlessly target the regime’s ability to generate, move, and repatriate funds.”.

item.title: "Why Would I Tell You That?" Trump Evades Reporter's Question On Iran Strikes
item.description: Trump evaded a reporter's question on potential Iran strikes. Iran has maintained its stranglehold on the Strait of Hormuz, cutting off vast amounts of oil. "Why Would I Tell You That?" Trump Evades Reporter's Question On Iran Strikes.
